verdict.rationale: Steel exposes a documented REST API (OpenAPI spec, steel-probe-2), an official CLI (steel-docs-8, steel-probe-3), and native connectivity via Puppeteer/Playwright/Selenium (steel-gh-1), plus first-party integrations with major agent frameworks (AI SDK, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Pydantic AI, AgentKit) that act as official SDK-level bindings for AI-native development.  Missing for 10: explicit named client-library SDKs (e.g., dedicated Python/Node package docs) and independent/hands-on developer confirmation of SDK ergonomics beyond vendor docs.
